**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve unknowns for wholly unobserved service windows**

When a run stops before a service window begins, `selected` is empty and these `sum(...)` calls serialize C/A/E/N—and consequently latency, quantization, and physical shortfall—as numeric zero. This already affects all five windows in `[1500,3000)`, so the machine-readable CSV/JSON cannot distinguish missing observations from measured zero service and contradicts `FINAL_SCIENTIFIC_REVIEW.md`'s claim that missing values were not filled with zero. Emit null/blank measurement and derived fields when `selected` is empty, while retaining numeric partial sums for windows with observed steps.
